remaining_conditions: complete the Linux/AArch64 reserve, commit, decommit, purge, protect, unmap, reuse, huge-page, hint, overmap, and NUMA substrate with fault-injection evidence
prove all source memory-ID ownership branches and metadata allocation/free paths, including retry-preserving failure behavior
complete the source-shaped bitmap ownership, range, visitor, statistics, and concurrency contract
add the pinned-C producer and compare the full selected lifecycle trace, including extension and release failure branches
resolve the documented C static-empty-root versus Rust poisoned cold-initialization failure difference
complete multi-arena search, claim, release, purge scheduling, and reuse semantics with ownership checks
complete source-order process, OS, options, TLS, arena, publication, and shutdown initialization semantics
exercise allocation, commit, map, metadata, bitmap, PageMap, arena, and release failures without leaking or changing ownership
prove every M2 metadata and substrate path remains allocation-free or uses the reviewed recursion boundary under same-thread reentry

exclusions.reason: page headers, free lists, local allocation, and regular-page state are not M2 memory-substrate closure
small and medium allocation behavior remains a later engine milestone
public libc backend selection, ABI integration, and production promotion are outside this substrate gate
the project contract supports Linux/AArch64 little-endian only

milestone.completion_rule: M2 is complete only when all eight categories are complete, every named condition is cleared, and current-commit native Linux/AArch64 evidence covers the full selected substrate and failure matrix.
nonclaims: the successful Rust PageMap trace is not C/Rust differential parity
the successful PageMap trace does not cover cold-root initialization failure or fault injection
this gate does not claim a production allocator backend or any later allocator milestone
this gate does not claim non-AArch64 support
